Fieldwork

Some data has to be collected on foot.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students out of the classroom and into their own neighbourhoods to study real problems and work with the community, with a mentor checking the work along the way. The training data is the street outside.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Want to build AI that knows the real world? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students study real problems in their neighbourhood with the community, and every piece of work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
